paragraphs.text: What is .NET used for? .NET is Microsoft's free, open-source development platform for building web applications, APIs, desktop software, cloud services and background systems, mainly in the C# language. Modern .NET runs on Windows, Linux and macOS, and Microsoft releases a long-term support version every two years.

ASP.NET Core is the part of .NET used for websites and web APIs. In the 2025 Stack Overflow Developer Survey, about 19% of developers reported using ASP.NET Core, making it one of the most widely used web frameworks in business software.

Is .NET good for enterprise applications? Yes, it is one of the platform's main strengths. .NET offers strong typing, mature security features, excellent performance, deep integration with Microsoft products such as Active Directory, Office 365 and SQL Server, and long-term support from Microsoft. Banks, insurers, logistics companies and government suppliers have relied on it for decades. Its tooling also makes large codebases easier to test and refactor safely.

items.title: ASP.NET Core Development
items.text: ASP.NET Core development covers new web applications built on Microsoft's modern, cross-platform framework. As a .NET web application development team, we plan users, screens and data first, then build in two-week sprints with a working demo at the end of each.

items.title: Custom .NET Software Development
items.text: Custom .NET software development replaces spreadsheets, paper processes and ageing desktop tools with secure, browser-based systems. Typical projects include approval workflows, inventory and job tracking, finance tools and staff management systems.

items.title: .NET API Development
items.text: .NET API development connects your systems to mobile apps, partner platforms, payment providers and accounting software. Every endpoint is documented, secured with token-based authentication and covered by automated tests. Sample requests are shared with your partners, so integration work can start in the first week.

items.title: Blazor Development
items.text: Blazor development lets us build interactive web interfaces in C#, the same language used on the server. For organisations with existing C# skills, Blazor keeps the whole application in one language, which simplifies maintenance and hiring. Where a richer front end is needed, we pair .NET APIs with Angular or React instead.

items.title: C# Development Services and SQL Server Development
items.text: Our C# development services cover business logic, background processing, integrations and reporting. SQL Server development includes database design, stored procedures, performance tuning, backups and reporting queries, using Entity Framework Core where it fits.

paragraphs.text: Typical projects include claims and policy servicing tools for insurance teams, shipment and warehouse systems for logistics firms, approval and procurement workflows for manufacturers, staff and payroll support tools for HR departments, and reporting portals that pull data from several SQL Server databases into one view. Most need strict permissions, detailed audit logs and reliable integration with Microsoft tools.

sections.h2: Hosting on Azure, Windows or Linux

paragraphs.html: Modern .NET applications can run on Microsoft Azure, on your own Windows servers or on lower-cost Linux hosting. We recommend the option that fits your existing infrastructure, security rules and budget, and set up automated deployments, backups and monitoring for each.

paragraphs.text: Many business systems still run on the older .NET Framework, which is Windows-only and no longer receives new features. .NET Framework to .NET Core migration moves these applications to modern .NET, which is faster, runs on Linux or Windows, and supports current hosting, containers and cloud services.

We migrate in planned stages: a code audit first, then shared libraries, then each module, with full testing in a staging copy before every release. Your staff keep working throughout, and we document every change, so future developers are never starting blind.

paragraphs.html: .NET vs Java for enterprise is a common decision for large systems. Both are mature, fast, secure and well supported. .NET fits best where an organisation already uses Microsoft tools, SQL Server, Azure or Office 365, and offers a highly productive developer experience with C#. Java suits organisations standardised on Java tools and Linux-based enterprise platforms.

paragraphs.text: For most businesses in India and the GCC that already run Microsoft infrastructure, .NET usually means faster delivery and simpler integration.

sections.h2: How Much Does .NET Development Cost in India?

paragraphs.text: How much does .NET development cost in India? It depends on the number of modules, user roles, integrations and reports, and on whether existing code must be migrated. Licensing can also matter: SQL Server and Windows hosting carry costs, while modern .NET on Linux with open-source databases can reduce them.
Every project is quoted after discovery. Each quote from our dot net development company Kochi office is fixed for the agreed scope and lists exactly what is included.
